name: akansh-mowar-lockworks
description: The Lockworks — personal engineering portfolio for Akansh Mowar (DevOps / Platform / Cloud Engineer).

scripts.prebuild: npm run evidence && npm run audit:source && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run assets:check
scripts.assets: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/export-content.mjs && python3 scripts/build_pdf.py && python3 scripts/build_images.py && node scripts/check-assets.mjs --write
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run audit:source && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run assets:check && npm run build
